summary: Iteration 28 full regression (backend + frontend) for the Kadenza rebrand + referral program + cookie consent + wizard draft-save + CORS/Sentry init. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (health checks, CORS preflight, /api/referrals/me shape+auth, signup without/with/bad referral, full referral credit flow both sides, admin login). Frontend: (1) Landing/legal/404/public-video pages all show 'Kadenza' brand — zero occurrences of legacy 'AI Video Studio' anywhere I checked (landing, /terms, /privacy, /404, /v/<bogus>, /login, /forgot-password, /reset-password, /pricing, /admin). (2) Cookie consent banner shows after ~700ms on first visit, both buttons persist choice in localStorage['avs_cookie_consent_v1'] and banner stays hidden across reloads. (3) /signup?ref=XQEBLM shows the green referral-banner with the code, and registering a new user (referral_test_<ts>@example.com) with confirm-password yielded credits=6 and referred_by=user_a9db... on /auth/me. Admin's /referrals/me invited_count went 2→3 and credits_earned went 6→9, and admin's total credits went 10006→10015 (initial + prior tests + this run's +3). (4) Settings page shows all 6 ReferralPanel data-testids (panel, code, share-url, copy-btn, share-btn, invited-count, credits-earned). (5) Wizard draft-save on /new works: typing a topic persists to localStorage['avs_wizard_draft_v1'], reload shows a 'Draft restored' toast + restores the topic, and clearing the topic removes the draft. (6) Admin login lands on /dashboard with credit-badge (10015 CREDITS) + admin badge + admin sidebar link visible. 0 React/console errors during full session.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at ~2881 lines. The referral utilities (_generate_unique_referral_code / _ensure_referral_code / _apply_referral_bonus) and the /referrals/me endpoint are cleanly scoped, but consider splitting server.py into feature modules (auth.py, referrals.py, wizard.py, admin.py) before it hits 3.5k lines.

MINOR: /api/referrals/me `share_url` currently derives the origin from request.url.hostname, which resolves to the internal cluster hostname (http://script-to-video-382.cluster-7.preview.emergentcf.cloud/signup?ref=XXXXXX) instead of the public preview URL that users see. In production this only matters if PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset — Kubernetes ingress rewrites the Host header. Recommend setting PUBLIC_APP_URL=<external URL> in backend/.env, or falling back to X-Forwarded-Host/X-Forwarded-Proto. Copy/share still works because the /signup?ref=CODE path is correct and both hosts eventually reach the same app.

MINOR: CookieConsent banner appears every ~700ms after mount even on authenticated pages (e.g., /dashboard) if the visitor hasn't consented yet. This is expected behaviour but visually competes with app UI on first login. Consider gating it to unauthenticated routes only, or letting it live in a lower z-index on authenticated pages.

Wizard draft key is 'avs_wizard_draft_v1' but cookie key is 'avs_cookie_consent_v1' — inconsistent with the Kadenza rebrand. Not a bug (backward compatibility with any user with an existing localStorage value), but might want to migrate to 'kdz_' keys eventually to match the brand.

rca of the issue: No functional bugs found in this iteration. Only cosmetic/architectural suggestions noted above under critical_code_review_comments.
